opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell Home, Ruud speaking. How can I help?
opening.comment: The agent gave the company name and their own name in the first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Right, done, changed uh order 391827 to 22 Lindengracht.
verification.comment: The agent changed the address without first confirming the caller's full name and the order number or postcode on the account; ask for the full name and postcode before changing account data.

understanding.quote: Customer: It's 22 lindengrakht, 1015 KD amsterdams. The order is 391827.
understanding.comment: The agent captured the new address and order number, though the agent did not clearly confirm the caller's actual need after the dispatch question.

resolution_accuracy.quote: yeah, it was dispatched yesterday, but that doesn't matter, the courier will go to the new address.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Address changes are only possible before dispatch, so the agent wrongly promised the change would work and gave an unsupported delivery timeline of 2 to 4 working days.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Fine. Give me the new address.
process_compliance.comment: No hold occurred, so no permission step was needed, and the call involved no damaged item, bank dispute, or voucher, so the applicable process steps were met.

communication.quote: Agent: Oh. Okay, I hope so, I really need that sofa cover.
communication.comment: The caller said they were stressed and it was urgent, but the agent did not acknowledge the caller's stress or show empathy.

closing.quote: Agent: Thanks for calling Tidewell. Bye.
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else but did not confirm the next steps clearly and closed abruptly; confirm the change status and what happens next before ending.
